Subject: Interest in Redwood for GitHub Actions integration

Hi Tessa —

I signed up for a trial earlier and am evaluating Redwood for a GitHub Actions–based CI that needs low-latency inference for our open-source code analysis tools. A few quick questions before we lock a demo:

- Do you require org-level installation (GitHub App) or can we demo with a repo-level token?
- What permission scopes are needed for the integration?
- We have strict OSS contributor privacy concerns — can you explain how data flows during a hosted demo?

Happy to do a quick call next week. Our maintainer team is pacific time (PST).

Thanks,

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks for signing up and for the clear questions. Happy to run a short demo and cover the integration details. A few notes up front:

- We can demo with a repo-level token for an initial walkthrough; for production we typically recommend the GitHub App for org installs.
- Typical scopes for full functionality: repo (contents, workflows) and admin:org for org-level webhooks (we can demo reduced-scope flows).
- For hosted demos, request payloads are stripped of contributor identifiers by default and we can enable additional anonymization. We also have a private deployment option if you need no hosted processing.

Would any of these slots work for a 30-min demo (PST)?
- Tue Jan 12, 11:00–11:30 AM PST
- Tue Jan 12, 2:00–2:30 PM PST
- Wed Jan 13, 9:30–10:00 AM PST

If you prefer a different time, let me know your availability and timezone. I’ve cc’d Marissa (AE) who will be on the call for next-steps and Ben (SE) can join to cover the permissions and deployment options — I’ll loop him in once you confirm a slot.

Attachments: quick 1-pager agenda I’ll follow if helpful.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
SDR, Redwood Inference
